text:
emily: Quick friday micro-review — run history shows tool calls that return structured data. I'm proposing a small pill + signature row and a compact mode icon. Need a11y + copy guidance before I ship.

leah: Drop the mock pls. makes it easier to comment.

emily: Collapsed mock: `PaymentResponse (Schema) · 2 fields · tool: payments_service` with a blue rounded pill that says `Schema` and a muted signature below `payments.getPaymentStatus(payment_id: string)` (truncated). Expanded mock shows `PaymentResponse` heading, key/value grid, and a `Raw JSON` tab.

marco: Truncation: if signature overflows we should show `...` and provide a tooltip with full signature on hover + reveal on focus. That keeps rows tidy.

tariq: Agree on tooltip. For screen readers, tooltip isn't enough — add `aria-describedby` pointing to a visually hidden element containing the full signature.

emily: Good call. So: visible truncated text + `aria-describedby` with full signature node. Also add a small copy icon next to signature that copies the signature and fires an `aria-live=\"polite\"` toast saying "Signature copied".

leah: Pill color: the blue you're using is #e6f2ff bg + #0366d6 text? contrast is fine but the bg tint should be lower saturation so it doesn't look like a primary CTA. Maybe #e9f5ff bg.

marco: Icon idea: use braces {} inside the pill, with accessible name `Schema` so in compact (icon-only) mode the svg has `role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Schema\"`.

emily: Noted. Proposed collapsed copy variant: `PaymentResponse (Schema) — payments.getPaymentStatus()` (signature shortened to fnName only). Would that be acceptable?

tariq: I'm cautious about losing parameter visibility — ops often need to see which param was used. Suggest keeping `fnName(params...)` in tooltip, but show `fnName(...)` inline.

leah: UX tiny: separate source with a middot: `PaymentResponse (Schema) · payments.getPaymentStatus()` instead of using `tool:` label. Keeps lines shorter.

emily: Great. Keyboard: when you hit Enter/Space on the row it expands. When expanded, focus should jump to the heading inside the panel. Escape collapses and returns focus to the row.

marco: For the table view inside expanded — add `role=\"table\"` and `aria-label=\"PaymentResponse fields\"`. Also ensure column headers exist for `field` and `value` with `scope` attributes so NVDA reads them.

tariq: Could we show a tiny token/cost estimate on the preview tab? e.g., `Formatted (23 tokens)` so devs can gauge cost. aria-live updates when switching tabs.

emily: Love the cost badge. I'll add `Formatted (23 tokens)` and `Raw JSON`. Copy button should copy compact JSON (no pretty print) by default, with a small chevron to copy pretty too. That might be overkill but helpful.

leah: Accessibility nit: ensure the icon-only pill in compact rows has a 44x44 hit area (even if icon visually smaller). Also provide keyboard focus style: 2px ring with accessible color, not just box-shadow.

marco: One more: screen reader order in collapsed row — prefer `Heading: PaymentResponse`, then `Type: Schema`, then `From: payments.getPaymentStatus` then `Items: 2 fields`. So sr users get context quickly.

emily: I'll add SR string on the row: `aria-label=\"PaymentResponse, Schema, from payments.getPaymentStatus, 2 fields\"`.

tariq: For tests: quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass, keyboard nav, tooltip announcement check, copy-to-clipboard SR toast. Add a visual contrast snapshot for the pill.

emily: I'll attach the figma and PR notes. ux-bot — can you generate a compact and expanded screenshot with the alt text and contrast numbers?

ux-bot: @emily generated screenshots + contrast report: compact_icon_only.png, collapsed_with_tooltip.png, expanded_table_a11y.png. Link: https://figma.redwood.team/s/PLAYGROUND-SCHEMA-2467500000

emily: Perfect — final checklist going into PR: 1) pill text `Schema` (sentence case), braces icon with `aria-label`, 2) collapsed copy `PaymentResponse (Schema) · payments.getPaymentStatus()`, truncated inline with tooltip + `aria-describedby`, 3) keyboard interactions (Enter to open, Esc to close, focus management), 4) expanded view `role=table` + headers, 5) tabs `Formatted (N tokens)` / `Raw JSON`, 6) `Copy JSON` button with aria-live toast, 7) compact mode icon-only pill (44x44 hit area), 8) contrast screenshots and test plan. Any last calls before I file the PR?

leah: No blockers from design side. ship it when you add tests.

emily: Thanks! I'll open the PR and tag you all. :rocket:
